- Agent: WebSurfer

  -- Observation: Found that "New Jersey Drive" was released in 1995 and "It Happened at the World's Fair" was released in 1963.  
  -- Thought: Compared the release years to determine which film was older.  
  -- Result: Confirmed that "It Happened at the World's Fair" was released earlier than "New Jersey Drive."  

- Agent: Planner

  -- Observation: Monitored the progress of the WebSurfer's searches.  
  -- Thought: Verified the release years from multiple sources to ensure accuracy.  
  -- Result: Consolidated the findings to determine the correct release order.
